nodes.name: Read status.json
nodes.notes: Reads the Phase 3A dashboard output. Safe alternative to Execute Command (disabled in n8n 2.0+).

nodes.name: Parse & Status Route
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: Uses explicit === string comparisons. NO IF Nodes. NO truthy/falsy logic. See n8n/code-nodes/status-router.js.

nodes.name: Redact Response
nodes.notes: Redacts sensitive data: strips run_path, summarizes artifacts as counts. See n8n/code-nodes/redaction.js.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Returns redacted JSON response. NO agents started. NO runners launched.
